description_en: Queries a message by exact match. The Message ID required for the query is obtained from the SendResult returned each time a message is sent successfully
description_zh: 精确查询。查询条件需要的 Message ID 从每次消息发送成功的 SendResult 中获取
kebab_example: aliyun sofa get-mq-sofamq-message-by-id --cell RZ01A --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --msg-id 1E0578FE110F18B4AAC235C05F200000 --topic test-mq_topic --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMqSofamqMessageById

parameters.help_en: The cell where the message to query resides
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息所在的单元
parameters.name: cell

parameters.help_en: The instance ID associated with the message to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces
parameters.help_zh: 需查询消息所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message to query, that is, the Message ID
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息的 ID，即 Message ID
parameters.name: msg_id

parameters.help_en: The topic of the message to query
parameters.name: topic
